verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HubSpot's CRM manages deal records, which can be imported and accessed via the MCP server. It also cites AI-driven "smart deal progression" that keeps deals moving, which implies a stage-based deal flow. Nothing in the pack documents a visual pipeline board, customizable stages, or drag-and-drop updates. missing for 10: evidence of a visual pipeline/board view, customizable deal stages, drag-and-drop stage updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration
